name: Dopewars
author: Ninepoint Labs
description: The classic dopewars (Drug Wars) turn-based trading game, the whole single-player game living in a bar panel. Your game is saved after every move, so take a turn whenever you feel like it.

barWidget.description: Play dopewars from the bar: buy low, sell high, dodge the cops, pay off the loan shark. Auto-saves between turns.
